Escalation dei privilegi

An attack or exploit in which a user or application gains higher access rights or privileges than intended by system policy.

Questions and answers

What is Escalation dei privilegi?

In this glossary, Escalation dei privilegi refers to: An attack or exploit in which a user or application gains higher access rights or privileges than intended by system policy.

How is Escalation dei privilegi used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Gli attaccanti possono sfruttare le vulnerabilità software per ottenere una escalation dei privilegi, ottenendo l’accesso amministrativo da un account utente standard."

Definition

An attack or exploit in which a user or application gains higher access rights or privileges than intended by system policy.

Operational example

Attackers may exploit software vulnerabilities for privilege escalation, gaining administrator access from a standard user account.

Localized term

Localized example
